frozen_object.allowed_data: exact rates, finite generators, stationary probabilities, eigenmodes, kernels and mixing bounds
frozen_object.arithmetic_origin: none; queue states and rates are source-defined
frozen_object.determinant_convention: finite characteristic polynomial only; no infinite Fredholm determinant
frozen_object.forbidden_data: prime or zero tables, target labels, Euler factors, root numbers, automorphy and Route-B input
frozen_object.normalization: row-stochastic transition kernel and probability stationary vector
frozen_object.parameters: lambda,mu>=0 rates, integer capacity K>=0, physical time t>=0
frozen_object.state_space: {0,1,...,K}, where K includes the customer in service
frozen_object.symmetrization: S=D_pi^(1/2) Q D_pi^(-1/2), with off-diagonal sqrt(lambda*mu)

headline: Finite-capacity M/M/1/K birth--death queues admit an exact reversible kernel, full spectral gap atlas, and controlled infinite-capacity boundaries
nonclaims: priority for the finite M/M/1/K spectrum or queueing boundary classification
the finite ledger is a proof of an unqualified infinite-dimensional spectral theorem
any queue eigenvalue or state label is a target zero, prime, Euler factor or arithmetic local datum
an infinite Fredholm determinant, target divisor, functional equation or automorphy statement
a Hilbert--Polya operator, Route-B construction or external peer review

boundary_rows.law: single state 0; Q=[0], P_t(0,0)=1 and stationary mass is 1
state 0 is absorbing; every state reaches 0 deterministically through deaths
state K is absorbing; every state reaches K deterministically through births
every state is absorbing; each point mass is stationary and no unique stationary law exists
finite stationary law is uniform; infinite chain is null recurrent and has no probability stationary law
finite pi converges coordinatewise to (1-rho)rho^n and finite gap converges to (sqrt(mu)-sqrt(lambda))^2
finite stationary mass at every fixed state tends to 0 (mass escapes); no infinite stationary probability

route_a.strongest_failure: Queue state labels and rates carry no primitive arithmetic owner, target divisor or Hilbert--Polya bridge; the Jacobi matrix is a formal finite-dimensional analogy only.
route_a.strongest_positive: The finite generator has an intrinsic reversible Jacobi realization and an exact semigroup spectral atlas.

theorem.boundaries: K=0, lambda=0, mu=0 and both-zero faces are absorbing degeneracies; equal rates are finite uniform but infinite null recurrent.
theorem.distinction: This is a reversible birth--death semigroup with capacity reflection, not the branching PGF of C208 and not the interacting-particle matrix-ansatz phase atlas of C220.
theorem.eigenbasis: A normalized eigenvector for nu_j has components proportional to sin((n+1)theta_j)-sqrt(mu/lambda)sin(n theta_j), theta_j=j*pi/(K+1).
theorem.infinite_capacity: As K->infinity, rho<1 has geometric stationary convergence and gap limit (sqrt(mu)-sqrt(lambda))^2; rho=1 has gamma_K~lambda*pi^2/(K+1)^2 and no stationary probability; rho>1 finite stationary mass escapes and no stationary probability exists.
theorem.infinite_scope: No assertion is made here about a continuous-spectrum decomposition of the infinite generator; only the stated stationary and gap/boundary limits are claimed.
theorem.jacobi: D_pi^(1/2) Q D_pi^(-1/2) is a symmetric tridiagonal Jacobi matrix with off-diagonal sqrt(lambda*mu).
theorem.kernel: P_t(i,j)=sqrt(pi_j/pi_i) sum_{m=0}^K v_m(i)v_m(j)exp(nu_m t), with v_0=sqrt(pi) and nu_0=0.
theorem.mixing: The spectral gap is gamma_K=lambda+mu-2sqrt(lambda*mu)cos(pi/(K+1)); TV distance from i is at most 1/2 sqrt(pi_i^{-1}-1) exp(-gamma_K t).
theorem.spectrum: For K>=1 the eigenvalues are 0 and nu_j=-(lambda+mu)+2sqrt(lambda*mu)cos(j*pi/(K+1)), j=1,...,K.
theorem.stationary: For lambda,mu>0 and K>=1, pi_n=(lambda/mu)^n / sum_{r=0}^K(lambda/mu)^r; at equal rates pi is uniform; K=0 is singleton.
